items.title: Earl Humphrey Interview, 1968-11-30
items.q: Well, always, take Piku, Loretta Teo, Charlie McCready

ctx.x: I forget his name. That's his last name, Harrison. He lived in Algiers. Oh, it's his last name? Ray Trombone player. I never knew his first name. That's all I used to call him. Harrison. Yeah. I see. Who were, at that time, in the twenties there, who would consider the outstanding caranac guys
in the U.A.s, would you say? Well, always, take Piku, Loretta Teo, Charlie McCready, and the other guy, and the other guy,
you know, down that line like that.
